title: AstroTransit Portfolio: Vetted Non-TOI Temperate Exoplanet Candidates from TESS Photometry (v3 Rigorous Release)
description: Rigorous evidence package containing empirical MCMC parameter estimations, individual False Positive Probability (FPP) vetting reports, and 300 DPI light curve fits for vetted Non-TOI exoplanet candidates (FPP < 0.02) discovered using AstroTransit.
